## Pipeline stage 2: Extract text

### Extracted record


###

```json
{
  "ref_id": ["3c2d9733-f0cd-48ab-b343-1ad60484d4e8"], // <1>
  "step_id": "8a41f0c2-6b9e-4d3a-a7f5-2e1c9b0d4f86", // <2>
  "previous_step_id": [], // <3>
  "metadata": { // <4>
    "filepath": "swerik/records/data/197879/prot-197879--163.xml",
    "source_uri": "https://swerik-project.github.io/riksdagen-records-pdf/197879/prot-197879--163",
    "date_created": "1979-05-31",
    "processing_details": [
      {
        "description": "Extract the text of each SWERIK protocol.",
        "git_details": {
          "commitid": "157d41aadab7d5dd37183a96b2ebff5ce3e848d1",
          "timestamp": "2026-10-13T13:02:11.204718+00:00",
          "testmode": true
        },
        "settings": "{}",
        "filepath_script": "oppna_data/swerik/scripts/run_extractor.py"
      }
    ]
  },
  "text": "Herr talman! ...", // <5>
  "tags": null, // <6>
  "scores": null // <6>
}
```

1. **Required.** The `id` of every reference record this document derives from. It is a list so that a step combining several documents can name all of them.
2. **Required.** Unique id of this record.
3. **Required.** The `step_id`s of the records this one was derived from. It is always empty after extraction, because the reference stage has no `step_id`. Records from later processing stages fill it in.
4. **Required.** Same fields as in the reference record. Each stage appends its own entry to `processing_details`.
5. The document text.
6. Optional JSON-encoded strings, for tags and quality scores added by later stages.
